visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed rotating hero carousel. Each slide is an edge-to-edge background photo with an overlaid text card (eyebrow/heading/description) anchored bottom-left, a CTA button, centered dot indicators, and prev/next navigation arrows.
contentPattern: One row per slide: cell 1 = slide image, cell 2 = content (heading + description + CTA link).
usage: Homepage hero (3 slides). Adventure detail hero image carousel (3 slides, images only, no overlaid text).
